stories.title: UCLA scientists discover how to guide heat like light at room temperature
stories.desc: Scientists have demonstrated that heat can move through a crystal in focused, wave-like rays at room temperature instead of spreading randomly. The breakthrough could make it possible to route heat around sensitive parts of next-generation chips and quantum devices.

stories.title: Never-before-seen woven structure that forms naturally inside a crystal discovered
